Check whether consensus at $1.01 sits at the midpoint, and look at the Q4 guide range.

Peer staffing prints and monthly data already out for the quarter: French and European temp-staffing indices (Prism'emploi, the Eurostat/ONS labour series), Randstad and Adecco commentary, US BLS temp-help employment for Jul-Sep
The positioning trail. About 10% of float is short (see short_interest) and the stock is +99% off its 52-week low but -11.5% over 20 days, so look at whether shorts rebuilt into this print
Divestiture flow (the Jefferson Wells US sale gave a $0.14 one-off in Q2): any further 8-K asset sales

trades_on: The last print traded on a beat plus the return to profit and a Q3 guide, +32% intraday (https://finviz.com/news/369105/manpowergroup-shares-jump-after-second-quarter-earnings-and-revenue-beat-forecasts-man). The share of that move owed to a short squeeze versus the guide is not established.
